name: openspec-ide-monorepo
description: OpenSpec IDE — расширение VS Code для работы по методологии OpenSpec

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/server && npm run build -w @openspec-ide/web && npm run build -w openspec-ide
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/server && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vscode
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.package: npm run build -w @openspec-ide/web && npm run package -w openspec-ide
